title: Industry unemployment with end labels
intent: Compare monthly unemployment in manufacturing, construction, and finance and label each industry's final observation directly, following Observable Plot's selectLast pattern.

source.title: Observable Plot select transform — multi-series end labels

ai.create: Create a responsive three-industry UTC line chart from the industries dataset's original date, industry, and unemployed fields. Give each industry a stable color and directly label its final observation without reshaping the observations.
ai.maintain: Move the direct labels from the last observation to the first observation of each industry while retaining industry colors, inferred callback data, and readable label space.
